Power Door Lock System
A power door lock system with a driver door key-linked door lock function, key lock-in prevention function, etc. is used.
The door lock assembly reduces the number of parts while also giving consideration to theft prevention, by using a housing integrated with the protector, a cable connection with the door inside handle, direct connection between the door key cylinder and door lock, and integration of the actuator housing and protector.
Grip type door outside handles are used for all doors, providing excellent operability.
Power Door Lock System Components
Power Door Lock System Main Component Functions
Components Main Function
Main Body ECU (Instrument Panel Junction Block Assembly)
Receives signals from various switches and controls the entire power door lock system.
Outputs lock/unlock signals to the door lock assemblies to drive the door lock control motors.
Door Lock Control Switch (for Manual Operation)
Outputs door lock/unlock request signals to the main body ECU.
Door Courtesy Light Switches (All Doors)
Detects the opening and closing of each door.
Driver Door Lock Assembly
Locks/unlocks the driver door by rotating the built-in driver door lock control motor forward/in reverse.
Outputs door lock/unlock request signals to the main body ECU through the built-in door lock control switch (for key-linked operation).
Door Lock Assemblies (Front Passenger/Rear RH/Rear LH)
Locks/unlocks each door by rotating the built-in door lock control motor forward/in reverse.
Back Door Lock Assembly (with Built-in Courtesy Light Switch)
Locks/unlocks the back door by driving the built-in back door lock control motor.
Detects the opening and closing of the back door.
Power Door Lock System Wiring Diagram
Main Functions List
Main Function Outline
Manual Lock <Unlock> Function Lock/unlock using the door lock control switch (for manual operation).
Door Key-linked Lock <Unlock> Function Lock/unlock by inserting the mechanical key into the driver door key cylinder.
Key Lock-in Prevention Function A function that does not lock the doors while the key is left in the cabin.
Door Lock Security Function A function that prevents unlocking with the door lock control switch (for manual operation) on the cabin side when the doors have been locked with the wireless function/smart function.
